summary: A hand-entered dataset whose values were all set to 0 now keeps its zeros when a length is changed, and keeps the new lengths when values are pasted in and saved.
details: Changing a length used to reload the dataset's saved file over the zeros, and pasting values then snapped the length controls back to the file's stored period.

The grid is now rebuilt empty at the new lengths without a reload, the controls hold those lengths until the values are saved or set back to 0, and the save writes a new file at that shape in place of the old one.
